name: TidalSync Server
author: will@fatty.dev
description: TidalSync WebSocket sync server. Assign one allocation port — the process binds to SERVER_PORT automatically.
startup: if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" == "1" ]]; then echo "Pulling latest..."; git pull --ff-only || true; fi; echo "Installing dependencies..."; npm install --include=dev; echo "Building server..."; npm run build:server; echo "Starting TidalSync server on port {{SERVER_PORT}}..."; export PORT={{SERVER_PORT}}; exec node dist/server/index.js

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd /mnt/server

echo "Updating packages..."
apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y git curl ca-certificates

git config --global --add safe.directory /mnt/server || true

if [ "$(ls -A /mnt/server 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
    if [ -d .git ]; then
        ORIGIN=$(git config --get remote.origin.url || true)
        if [ "${ORIGIN}" = "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
            echo "Existing repo matches — pulling..."
            git fetch --all
            if [ -n "${GIT_BRANCH}" ]; then
                git checkout "${GIT_BRANCH}" || true
                git pull --ff-only origin "${GIT_BRANCH}" || git pull --ff-only || true
            else
                git pull --ff-only || true
            fi
        else
            echo "Directory not empty and remote mismatch — leaving files as-is."
        fi
    else
        echo "Directory not empty (no .git) — leaving files as-is."
    fi
else
    echo "Cloning ${GIT_ADDRESS}..."
    if [ -z "${GIT_BRANCH}" ]; then
        git clone --depth 1 "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
    else
        git clone --depth 1 --single-branch --branch "${GIT_BRANCH}" "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
    fi
fi

if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
    echo "ERROR: package.json not found after install"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Installing npm packages (including build tools)..."
npm install --include=dev

echo "Building WebSocket server..."
npm run build:server

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "TidalSync Server install complete"
echo "-----------------------------------------"
exit 0

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Branch to clone. Leave empty for the repo default branch.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Pull the latest git changes on every startup (1 = yes, 0 = no).
